rules.title: Admin dashboard content structure
rules.description: Dashboard extends admin base, shows header, welcome copy, and a statistics grid with stat cards.

rules.title: Stat card macro markup
rules.description: Reusable stat card partial used on the admin dashboard.

rules.title: Admin sidebar navigation
rules.description: Controlled admin UI exposes sidebar links for dashboard, users, sellers, and categories.

rules.title: Admin layout and stat card styles
rules.description: Theme styles for admin shell, sidebar, main column, and dashboard stat cards.

descriptions.test_unauthenticated_get_admin_redirects: Verifies GET /admin/ without a session returns 302 to the web login route.
descriptions.test_customer_session_get_admin_redirect: Verifies a logged-in customer receives 302 to login when requesting /admin/ (role guard).
descriptions.test_admin_get_dashboard_returns_200_wit: Verifies an admin user sees HTTP 200 with admin-layout, sidebar, and dashboard title.
descriptions.test_admin_dashboard_renders_stat_grid_w: Verifies stat-grid and multiple stat-card blocks with role labels after seeding three users.
descriptions.test_admin_users_page_accessible_for_adm: Verifies GET /admin/users returns 200 with admin layout and Users copy for an admin session.
descriptions.test_admin_login_redirects_to_admin_dash: Verifies POST /login as admin returns 302 to /admin per role-based redirect.

error_messages.test_unauthenticated_get_admin_redirects: Unauthenticated users must be redirected from /admin to login.
error_messages.test_customer_session_get_admin_redirect: Customers must not access the admin blueprint.
error_messages.test_admin_get_dashboard_returns_200_wit: Admins must receive the dashboard page with layout chrome.
error_messages.test_admin_dashboard_renders_stat_grid_w: Dashboard must render the statistics grid and cards.
error_messages.test_admin_login_redirects_to_admin_dash: Admin web login must redirect to the admin dashboard path.

tests.name: Unauthenticated admin URL redirects to login
tests.description: Opening /admin/ without a session should send the browser to the login page (controlled access).

assertions.error_message: Login form not visible after redirect

tests.name: Seeded admin login and dashboard UI
tests.description: Uses seed user admin@example.com / user123 from database/seed_data.sql; lands on /admin with layout and opens Users from the sidebar.
